column1: # FNV armor/clothing -> FO4 armor worn by converted NPCs (Fallout4.esm FormIDs).
# FNV armor meshes are skinned to the FNV skeleton and don't fit FO4 bodies yet, so NPC outfits use these
# FO4 substitutes. Rows are regular expressions on the FNV EditorID (case-insensitive), first match wins.
# FO4 ARMO empty: the item is dropped from the outfit (hats, glasses, Pip-Boys...).
